description.description: A description of what the integration does and how to use it

author.description: The name of the integration developer

contact.description: The URL or email address where users of the integration can reach out for support

uninstallation_url.description: The `delete` endpoint that initiates the uninstallation flow for the integration

oauth_callback_url.description: The `get` endpoint that will be invoked after OAuth authorization

tags.description: A list of tags that describe the type of integration

error_codes.description: An object containing error codes and their corresponding error message the integration may return to the OAuth failure page to be displayed

scopes.description: The list of OAuth token permissions the integration requests when installed

configuration_fields.description: A json-schema describing the settings fields that a user should be presented with when installing the integration
